claims: NCIS 500th episode is titled "All Good Things".
Director Leon Vance is played by Rocky Carroll.
Director Leon Vance was killed in NCIS 500th episode.
Director Leon Vance's killing marks NCIS's 18-season milestone.
Variety reported that Executive Producer Steven D. Binder designed the shocking death to turn the NCIS universe upside down.
Director Leon Vance died saving the agency.
The agency was under threat from a traitor.
Director Leon Vance died allowing him to leave as a hero after 18 seasons.
USA Today reported that Vance was killed in a shooting while exposing a traitor within the CID.
The traitor within the CID was trying to sabotage the agency.
Good Housekeeping revealed the exit was not actor Rocky Carroll's choice.
Rocky Carroll found out about his character's death just two episodes before filming his final scenes.
Deadline notes that Carroll felt it was a "full circle" moment to end an 18-year run.
Details are based on events from NCIS 500th episode.
